questions.question: What motivated you to go on exchange? (pick the most important one) *
questions.answer: Academic opportunities

questions.question: Which aspects were crucial to choosing your study destination? *
questions.answer: Nothing was particular crucial for me, but i knew i wanted to go somewhere further away than Europe.

questions.question: How would you rate your overall study abroad experience? *
Additional comments:
How easy was it to find the information you needed to know upon arrival? *
questions.answer: Easy

questions.question: What assistance, if any, did you receive when you arrived at your study destination? *
questions.answer: received plenty of assistance in form of an intro-day and several info mails etc.

questions.question: Overall, how satisfied were you with the orientation and assistance available to students at your host institution upon arrival? *
Additional comments
How did you find housing? *
questions.answer: I found housing on my own

questions.question: Did you live on campus or off campus? *
questions.answer: Off campus

questions.question: How easy was it to find off campus housing? Any recommendations? *
questions.answer: Det var let nok, vil jeg sige. Det er en smule dyrt, men det er det jo alle steder. Vi fandt noget gennem Nest Communities som tilbyder flere forskellige lejemuligheder rundt omkring i Ithaca og var meget gode

questions.question: What should future exchange students know about living off campus? *
questions.answer: Ikke bosæt jer for langt væk fra Collegetown. Det er her i gerne vil være. Specielt fordi Ithaca er en forholdsvis lille by, og der ikke sker det store. Derfor er det rart at være omkring alle de andre studerende, som næsten udelukkende opholder sig i Collegetown. Vi boede uden for det område, og det kunne til tider føles en smule isoleret.

questions.question: Overall, how satisfied were you with the housing available to students? *
Additional comments:
questions.answer: Jeg boede udenom

questions.question: How easy did you find the registration process at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
Please describe the registration process at your host institution *
questions.answer: Lidt usikker på hvad der menes, men alt i alt synes jeg det hele var super smooth. der er mange steps man skal igennem, men nemt.

questions.question: What kind of help was available? *
questions.answer: der var sikkert hjælp at hente, men man kan sagtens winge den selv.

questions.question: How successful were you in registering for the classes you wanted? *
questions.answer: det var også rigtig nemt og overskueligt. Du har tid til at prøve kurser af før du er låst, hvilket er dejligt.

questions.question: What advice would you offer to future exchange students about registration at your host institution? *
questions.answer: Undersøg kurserne grundigt inden så du ved hvilke du vil adde når de åbnes. De gode bliver hurtigt fyldt op.

questions.question: How satisfied were you with the academic programme at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
Were you a BA or MA student at UCPH when you were on exchange? *
questions.answer: BA

questions.question: Did you take BA or MA classes while you were on exchange *
questions.answer: BA

questions.question: Please elaborate on the level of courses *
questions.answer: Niveauet svinger utroligt meget afhængig af hvilket level du vælger (1000-4000 kurser). Jeg tog primært 1+2000 kurser da jeg gerne ville fokusere på andre ting også, og disse kurser var meget overskuelige. Der er en del mere workload end derhjemme så være forberedt på det! det forventes at du deltager aktivt og afleverer ting løbende under semesteret.

questions.question: How did the style of teaching at your host institution compare with that of UCPH? *
questions.answer: som alle andre steder er der ikke én form for undervisning og heller ikke her. Jeg havde timer hvor det var enormt interaktivt og diskuterende, og andre hvor det var mere forelæsningsdrevet. Det kommer an på underviseren. Udover det synes jeg at de minder meget om hinanden, bortset fra der selvfølgelig er en hierarkisk orden mellem lærer og elev i USA som ikke eksisterer på samme måde i DK.

questions.question: How long were you on exchange? *
questions.answer: 1 semester

questions.question: Please list the courses you were enrolled in during your first semester. *
questions.answer:
Thinking about the 60's and The Manson Murders
Anti-judaism and anti-semitism
Thinking Media
Introduction to Storytelling

questions.question: What specific courses would you recommend to future exchange students? Why? *
questions.answer: Hvis du er historiestuderende er kurser med Olga Litvak rigtig givende.

What unexpected costs did you encounter? *
questions.answer: Der var ikke som sådan nogle unexpected costs da vi først kom derover. Du skal bare være forberedt på at der kan dukke udforudsete ting op hvis du vælger at bo uden om uni

questions.question: What items were more or less expensive than you expected? *
questions.answer: Det er dyrt at spise ude og købe alkohol. men igen, nogenlunde det samme som københavn. Det afhænger også utroligt meget af dollarkursen

questions.question: How satisfied were you with the non-academic opportunities (clubs, sports, etc.) at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
What kinds of cultural, athletic and social activities were available for students at your host institution? *
questions.answer: Der var virkelig meget tilgængeligt for studerende. Så mange sociale ting, klubber, events og lignende. Hvis man er til det og har tiden og lysten, så gør det! Jeg tilmeldte mig Cornell Ski og Snowboard Club men fik desværre ikke tid til at bruge det.

questions.question: Which non -academic activities would you recommend to future exchange students? Why? *
questions.answer: Brug naturen! Det er helt sikkert det som området kan bedst.

questions.question: What do you recommend other visiting students see or do on their weekends or holidays? *
questions.answer: Jeg synes helt klart det var fedt at kunne hoppe på en Flixbus og tage til NY, Boston, Toronto osv. Brug landet mens i er der

questions.question: How easy was it to adjust to the local culture of your exchange site? *
questions.answer: Der gik selvfølgelig lidt tid før man faldt på plads. Selvom USA ikke er så forfærdeligt anderledes end DK, så er der stadig små ting som kan få det til at føles fremmed, hvilket er naturligt.

questions.question: Do you have any tips for socializing with local students?
questions.answer: De er super åbne, så match deres energi! De vil rigtig gerne være venner med dig fordi du kommer udefra. Ikke vig bort fra deres åbenhed, men prøv istedet at tving dig til at være på bølgelængde med dem. de er super sjove!

questions.question: What, if any, cultural differences did you find particularly challenging? *
questions.answer: Jeg fandt helt sikkert excentriciteten ved menneskene mest udfordrende til tider

questions.question: What parts of the culture did you most appreciate? *
questions.answer: På samme tid var serviceniveauet og folk så søde og åbne, man skal bare lige vænne sig til jargonen.

questions.question: What are the three most important things you would tell a UCPH student who is going to your host institution on exchange? *
questions.answer:
- Bo i Collegetown, hvis du vil bo udenom uni
- Engagér dig i sociale ting fra starten - Ithaca er en lille og stille provinsby og hvis ikke du har det sociale kan det føles langt og kedeligt. lav ture!
- Folk på college er meget unge. Overvej dette inden du tager derover. Jeg er 25 og på min bachelor. jeg havde undervisning med folk på 18, hvilket kan følges en smule gymnasieagtigt.

questions.question: Is there any other information that you think might prove useful to future exchange students attending your host institution? *
What was the most rewarding part of your exchange experience? *
questions.answer: Man lærer så meget om sig selv.

questions.question: What was the greatest challenge during the exchange? *
questions.answer: Finde glæde i små ting og lære at et følelsen af hjem nogle gange bare er et mindset

questions.question: Any other comments?
Do you agree to share your travel report with other fellow students? *
questions.answer: Yes
